protocol: source-RGB-only track membership and Gaussian initialization, supplied poses

controlled_branches.SelfRender: same A0, source schedule, pseudo cameras and pseudo schedule as B; target is the frozen A0 render itself
controlled_branches.B: same A0 and source schedule; target is the frozen Difix transform of the A0 render

pair_audit_binding: Each dataset/scene/seed A1-SelfRender-B group has a unique pair_id and its own passed pair-audit JSON; an audit from another group cannot authorize aggregation.
controlled_input_binding: A0 embeds its canonical input, camera, Track, strict-geometry and full training-parameter provenance inside the 10k checkpoint. Every continuation validates that embedded A0 provenance against its current inputs before training. Each 12k checkpoint embeds the exact parent A0 path/hash/provenance digest; B/SelfRender also embed the strict pseudo-manifest path/hash, camera-pool digest and target kind. Pair-audit v5 rehashes each exact final checkpoint, validates its role and A0/pseudo lineage, and includes it in the audited file inventory. A1/SelfRender/B must match the common input objects and hashes; fixed track/source-DSSIM/pseudo-loss values must equal the preregistered first-run values.
gate_json_policy: Every machine-readable gate must contain the exact JSON boolean passed=true; missing, false, malformed, or stale reports stop downstream stages.

projection_gate.stale_input_policy: recompute after any Track H5, environment, calibration, source image, protocol dimension, or relevant projection/training code change

pseudo_camera_gates.pre_A0_live: audit scene.getPseudoCameras() pose, intrinsics, resize convention and source-camera-only provenance
pseudo_camera_gates.post_A0_manifest: audit the exact 32 exported A0 pseudo-camera records and immutable manifest hash

final_claim: No real-scene efficacy claim before evidence gates pass
